- banner:

  - generic: harness · in memory
  - button "Recording as geist-synthetic · Direct entry"
  - button "Menu · Herd"
  - button "Search ⌘K"

- navigation "Section views":
  - link "Animals":
    - /url: /animals
  - link "Calvings":
    - /url: /animals/calvings
  - link "Health":
    - /url: /animals/health
- main:
  - heading "Add an acquired animal" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Only animals that arrived from elsewhere. A farm-born animal is created by its dam's calving — record the calving instead, and it appears as a consequence.
  - generic: Sex
  - radiogroup "Sex":
    - radio "female" [checked]:
      - generic: "1"
      - generic: female
    - radio "male":
      - generic: "2"
      - generic: male
  - generic: Name (optional)
  - textbox "Name (optional)"
  - generic: Acquired from (optional)
  - combobox "Acquired from (optional)"
  - generic: Who it came from. A stable identifier, not a display name.
  - generic: Post no. (optional)
  - textbox "Post no. (optional)"
  - generic: Ear tag (optional)
  - textbox "Ear tag (optional)"
  - paragraph: Post number and ear tag are attributes, not identity — both change over an animal's life.
  - group "When did it arrive on the farm?":
    - generic: When did it arrive on the farm?
    - generic: Date
    - textbox "Date":
      - /placeholder: 2019, Mar 2019, or 6 Jul 2023
    - checkbox "Even the year is a guess — only applies to a bare year, since an estimate is stored as January 1" [disabled]
    - generic: Even the year is a guess — only applies to a bare year, since an estimate is stored as January 1
    - paragraph: The precision is read from what you type and shown back — there is no default, because a default is how “exact day” gets applied to a guess.
  - group "Birth date — optional, but not its precision":
    - generic: Birth date — optional, but not its precision
    - generic: Date
    - textbox "Date":
      - /placeholder: 2019, Mar 2019, or 6 Jul 2023
    - checkbox "Even the year is a guess — only applies to a bare year, since an estimate is stored as January 1" [disabled]
    - generic: Even the year is a guess — only applies to a bare year, since an estimate is stored as January 1
    - paragraph: The precision is read from what you type and shown back.
  - paragraph: "Leave the birth date blank if you do not know it. Without one the animal shows as heifer or male even if it is visibly a calf — the age rule has no date to test. An estimated year is the fix: type the year and tick the guess box."
  - generic: Observed by (optional)
  - combobox "Observed by (optional)"
  - generic: Who actually saw it. Leave blank unless someone did — nobody observed a purchase record. A stable identifier, not a display name.
  - button "Add animal" [disabled]
  - generic: Enter the arrival date.
  - paragraph: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter saves from a field when the record is ready.
